user.title: Create ventilation control
user.description: Controls one central ventilation unit from room CO₂ and humidity sensors. Choose the entity that sets the unit's flow; everything else can be changed later in the options.

data_description.name: Name of the ventilation unit, used for the device and its entities.
data_description.actuator: The entity that sets the unit's flow: a number (m³/h or %), a fan (percentage) or a select (stages).
data_description.max_flow: Nominal maximum flow of the unit in m³/h. Leave empty to use the actuator's maximum if it is a number entity in m³/h. Default flows (minimum, fallback, quiet limit, boost) are calculated from it.

actuator.title: Actuator mapping
actuator.description: Tell the integration how the actuator's values relate to the flow.

data_description.actuator_unit: Whether the number entity takes a flow in m³/h or a percentage of the max flow.

inputs.description: Select the sensors in the rooms where people are. At least one CO₂ or humidity sensor is needed.

data_description.humidity_sensors: Humidity sensors in living and sleeping rooms only: no bathrooms, no rooms with a humidifier and no sensor in the extract duct.

init.title: Ventilation settings
init.description: Choose which settings to change. Saving applies them right away.

menu_option_descriptions.actuator: Actuator entity, max flow, off actuator and the native range.
menu_option_descriptions.inputs: Room CO₂ and humidity sensors and presence entities.

menu_option_descriptions.boosts: Default duration and level of a manual boost.

actuator.title: Actuator
actuator.description: Flow values were calculated from the max flow when the entry was created and do not follow a change of it (max flow {max_flow} m³/h, minimum {min_flow} m³/h, fallback {fallback_flow} m³/h, quiet limit {quiet_max_flow} m³/h, boost {boost_default_level} m³/h). Adjust them in the control and boost settings if needed.

data_description.actuator: The entity that sets the unit's flow: a number (m³/h or %), a fan (percentage) or a select (stages).
data_description.max_flow: Nominal maximum flow of the unit in m³/h.

off.name: Off actuator
off.description: Optional entity that stops the unit. Without it, off means the lowest actuator value.

data_description.off_entity: A switch or input boolean that stops the unit (e.g. a standby switch), or a fan that is turned off.
data_description.off_state: Which state of the off actuator means the unit is stopped. A standby switch stops the unit when it is on. Ignored for a fan.

range.name: Native range
range.description: Override the minimum and maximum value of the actuator. Leave empty to use the entity's own limits.

data_description.actuator_min: Lowest value written to the actuator, in its own unit.
data_description.actuator_max: Highest value written to the actuator, in its own unit.

actuator_mapping.title: Actuator mapping
actuator_mapping.description: Tell the integration how the actuator's values relate to the flow.

data_description.actuator_unit: Whether the number entity takes a flow in m³/h or a percentage of the max flow.

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: Sensors and entities the demand is calculated from.

rooms.name: Room sensors
rooms.description: Sensors in the rooms where people are. At least one CO₂ or humidity sensor is needed.

data_description.co2_sensors: CO₂ sensors in living and sleeping rooms. The highest valid value drives the CO₂ demand.
data_description.humidity_sensors: Humidity sensors in living and sleeping rooms only: no bathrooms, no rooms with a humidifier and no sensor in the extract duct.

presence.name: Presence
presence.description: Entities that tell whether someone is home, used by the away limit.

data_description.presence_entities: Persons, device trackers, zones, binary sensors or input booleans. Away means none of them is home; unavailable or unknown entities count as home.

control.title: Control
control.description: How room measurements become a flow.

co2.name: CO₂ ramp
co2.description: The flow rises linearly from the minimum flow at the start to the max flow at the end, using the highest valid CO₂ value.

data_description.co2_start: CO₂ value at which the flow starts to rise above the minimum flow.
data_description.co2_end: CO₂ value at which the max flow is reached.

flows.name: Flows
flows.description: Base flows of the automatic control.

data_description.min_flow: Lowest flow in automatic mode; keeps a basic air exchange for moisture protection.
data_description.fallback_flow: Flow used when CO₂ sensors are configured but none of them has a valid value.

humidity.name: Humidity
humidity.description: Humidity-high ramp and dryness protection, based on the living-area humidity sensors.

data_description.humidity_high_start: Highest room humidity at which the flow starts to rise above the minimum flow.
data_description.humidity_high_end: Highest room humidity at which the max flow is reached.
data_description.dryness_threshold: When the mean room humidity is below this value, the air counts as dry and the flow is limited to the CO₂ demand.
data_description.dryness_hysteresis: Dry ends only when the mean humidity is this much above the threshold, so the state does not flap.
data_description.dryness_humidity_high_limit: How long the humidity-high ramp may exceed the CO₂ demand while the air is dry. 0 suppresses it completely while dry.

quiet.name: Quiet limit
quiet.description: Caps the flow for low noise in the night window. The quiet profile applies it all day.

data_description.night_enabled: Apply the quiet limit in the night window. The quiet profile applies it all day regardless.
data_description.night_end: End of the night window; it may be on the next day.
data_description.quiet_max_flow: Maximum flow while the quiet limit applies. User boosts are not limited.
data_description.quiet_humidity_override: Above this highest room humidity the quiet limit does not apply.

away.name: Away
away.description: Minimum flow while nobody is home, unless the humidity is high.

data_description.away_enabled: Reduce the flow to the minimum while nobody is home, unless the humidity is high. Without presence entities it has no effect. Turning it off disables the away limit in every profile.

shaping.name: Output shaping
shaping.description: How calmly the unit runs: how often and how far the written flow may change.

data_description.min_write_interval: Minimum time between two changes of the flow. With the default the flow changes at most once every 5 minutes. Boosts and pauses act at once.
data_description.max_step_up: Largest increase per change. With the default (12.5 % of the max flow, 50 m³/h for a 400 m³/h unit) the flow rises in steps of 50 m³/h.
data_description.max_step_down: Largest decrease per change. With the default (12.5 % of the max flow, 50 m³/h for a 400 m³/h unit) the flow falls in steps of 50 m³/h.
data_description.deadband_up: The flow is only raised when the target is at least this much above the written flow. With the default, changes below 10 m³/h are ignored.
data_description.deadband_down: The flow is only lowered when the target is at least this much below the written flow. With the default, decreases below 20 m³/h are ignored, so the unit does not flap.
data_description.flow_quantum: Written flows are rounded to multiples of this value. With the default, to 5 m³/h.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: Technical timing parameters. The defaults fit most installations.

data_description.evaluation_interval: The control is evaluated at least this often, in addition to every input change.
data_description.debounce: Input changes within this time are evaluated together.
data_description.stale_timeout: An input that has not reported a value for this long is ignored.
data_description.startup_grace: After Home Assistant starts, nothing is written for this long so that all inputs can load.
data_description.problem_delay: How long a problem must persist before the problem sensor turns on.

boosts.title: Boosts
boosts.description: Defaults of manual boosts from the dashboard, services and voice.

manual.name: Manual boost
manual.description: A boost raises the flow to a level for a duration. Triggering it again extends it.

data_description.boost_default_duration: Duration of a boost when none is given.
data_description.boost_default_level: Flow of a boost when no level is given. The automatic demand still wins if it is higher.
data_description.boost_max_duration: Extending a boost never makes it last longer than this from now.

abort.already_configured: This entity already has a readiness condition.

error.not_correctable: The state of this entity cannot be set, so it cannot be corrected automatically.

user.title: Add readiness condition
user.description: An entity state the unit needs before writes to the actuator have an effect, e.g. a control mode. While it is not met, writes are suspended and a problem is reported.

data_description.entity_id: The entity whose state must match, e.g. the control mode select of the unit.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure readiness condition
reconfigure.description: An entity state the unit needs before writes to the actuator have an effect, e.g. a control mode. While it is not met, writes are suspended and a problem is reported.

data_description.entity_id: The entity whose state must match, e.g. the control mode select of the unit.

state.title: Expected state
state.description: Which state of {entity} the unit needs.

data_description.expected_state: Writes to the actuator only happen while the entity has this state.
data_description.auto_correct: Set the entity to the expected state before writing when it differs. Only possible for entities whose state can be set.

control_disabled.message: Control is switched off. Switch it on to boost or pause the ventilation.

level_out_of_range.message: The boost level must be between the minimum flow and the maximum flow.

entry_required.message: Choose the ventilation entry (config_entry_id). It can only be omitted if exactly one entry exists.

entry_not_found.message: {entry_id} is not a Better Home Ventilation entry.

boost.name: Boost
boost.description: Raises the flow to a level for a duration. A running boost is extended.

config_entry_id.name: Entry
config_entry_id.description: The ventilation entry. Optional if only one exists.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Duration in minutes. Default: the boost duration entity.

level.name: Level
level.description: Flow between the minimum flow and the maximum flow. Default: the boost level entity.

pause.name: Pause
pause.description: Stops the ventilation for a duration or until resumed.

config_entry_id.name: Entry
config_entry_id.description: The ventilation entry. Optional if only one exists.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Duration in minutes. Without a duration the pause lasts until resumed.

resume.name: Resume
resume.description: Ends a boost or a pause and returns to automatic control.

config_entry_id.name: Entry
config_entry_id.description: The ventilation entry. Optional if only one exists.
